messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — I'm curating a fresh set of dashboard examples for the Docs Sprint. Targeting a small set: cost/latency breakdown, tracehook quickstart, and an embeddable dashboard example. Planning to open a PR by EOD tomorrow. Any blockers?
ashley: SG. Can we make the cost example show per-route AND per-model breakdowns? people often ask for both. Also we should avoid internal-only metric names.
maya: Yep — I was going to use public metrics and an example mapping to route tags. Draft snippet below for the cost panel (very rough):
```
panels:
  - title: Cost by route
    type: bar
    series:
      - metric: redwood.cost.tokens
        labels: [route, model]
        aggregation: sum
      - metric: redwood.cost.cache_savings
        aggregation: sum
```
kevin: Nice. Two quick notes: 1) include a short callout explaining cache_savings semantics (prefix vs kv hits). 2) For latency we should recommend p50/p95 rather than mean.
jordan: Also, for the tracehook quickstart, can we add an explicit migration callout for teams moving from tracehook v1 -> v2? I can write a short blurb if you want.
maya: Please, that'd help. Maybe a tiny checklist: "what to change in instrumentation" + a one-liner example.
jordan: I'll paste a minimal change example: 
```
// v1
tracehook.add("route", {source: "sdk"})
// v2
tracehook.recordRoute({name: "route", origin: "sdk"})
```
ashley: Perfect. Also pinging docbot — pls run the link-scan once the PR is open. We have a couple of external redirects that cause false positives.
docbot: friendly reminder — the docs CI will automatically run linkcheck and snippet lint on PR open. If you want to skip linkcheck, add `[skip-linkcheck]` to the PR body.
maya: Good to know, thanks. One more ask: can we include a tiny embed example that shows how to surface the dashboard in our console via an iframe? I want a copy-paste that customers can adapt.
kevin: Keep the embed example minimal and security-minded. Suggest adding a CSP note and a short code sample: 
```
<iframe src="https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/embed/12345?token=${TOKEN}" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin"></iframe>
```
maya: Great. I'll add a brief CSP note and a warning about token scoping. Planning to split the PR into two commits: examples + migration notes, then link fixes after docbot output.
ashley: Sounds good. If you want a faster review on the cost panels, @kevin and I can batch-review tomorrow morning.
maya: Awesome, thanks. I'll post the PR link here when it's up. :pray:
deploy-bot: PR #4872: docs/dashboard-examples -> docs/main checks passed (linkcheck pending)
maya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4872 — posting for reviewers.
